name: Aaravi Filigree Gold Band

images.alt: Aaravi filigree gold band with hand-finished detailing
Gold band resting on a white surface

shortDescription: A slender 22KT band traced with hand-finished filigree.
description: Aaravi pairs a softly domed profile with delicate filigree that catches light from every angle. Slim enough to stack, substantial enough to wear alone, it is finished with a mirror polish inside for all-day comfort.

name: Solitaire Halo Diamond Ring

images.alt: Solitaire diamond ring with pavé shoulders in gold
Diamond solitaire ring seen from above

shortDescription: A luminous centre stone framed by a delicate halo in 18KT gold.
description: Designed for proposals and milestones, this solitaire sets a round brilliant diamond within a fine halo that amplifies its sparkle. The tapered shank keeps the silhouette light and elegant on the hand.

name: Twin Promise Couple Bands

images.alt: Two interlocking gold bands on cream fabric
Pair of wedding bands on a white surface

shortDescription: A matched pair of 22KT bands, sold together as a set.
description: Twin Promise is a pair of comfort-fit bands with a gently rounded profile — one slightly broader, one finer. Each can be engraved with a date or name to make the set entirely your own.

name: Heritage Trio Stacking Rings

images.alt: Three textured gold stacking rings
Three gold rings presented in a white box

shortDescription: Three textured 22KT rings designed to be worn together or apart.
description: A trio of rings in contrasting textures — beaded, twisted and polished — that layer beautifully. Wear all three for a heritage-inspired stack, or separate them across both hands.

name: Amethyst Crown Cocktail Ring

images.alt: Gold cocktail ring with a purple centre stone
Side view of the gold cocktail ring

shortDescription: A regal violet stone crowned in sculpted 18KT gold.
description: An evening ring with presence: a rich amethyst held in a crown-like gallery of gold claws. The open setting lets light pass through the stone for a deep, glowing colour.

name: Classic Dome Gold Ring

images.alt: Polished dome gold ring on white fabric
Gold dome ring on a white box

shortDescription: A timeless polished dome ring in 22KT gold.
description: Pure form, perfectly weighted. The Classic Dome is a wardrobe essential with a high-polish finish and a comfortable inner curve, made to be worn every day for years.

name: Twisted Gold Hoop Earrings

images.alt: Twisted gold hoop earrings resting on white stones
Gold hoop earring worn close-up

shortDescription: Softly twisted 22KT hoops with a secure hinged closure.

name: Petal Drop Gold Earrings

images.alt: Pair of petal drop gold earrings on white fabric
Close-up of gold drop earrings

shortDescription: Layered gold petals that sway gently with every movement.
description: Inspired by temple flowers, each earring cascades in layered petals of textured and polished gold. Lightweight for their size, they bring an effortless festive glow.

name: Diamond Cluster Stud Earrings

images.alt: Diamond cluster stud earrings in gold
Pair of stud earrings on white cloth

shortDescription: Floral diamond clusters set in 18KT gold with screw-back posts.
description: Small in scale and big on brilliance, these studs arrange diamonds in a floral cluster that reads as a single larger stone. Screw-back posts add security for everyday wear.

name: Rani Gold Jhumka Earrings

images.alt: Red and gold jhumka earrings on a wooden stand
Jhumka earrings hanging from a branch

shortDescription: Traditional bell jhumkas with red accents and granulated detailing.
description: Rani revisits the classic jhumka with fine granulation, a domed bell and delicate drops that move as you do. A signature piece for weddings and festive dressing.

name: Maharani Temple Gold Necklace

images.alt: Temple gold necklace displayed on a white bust
Gold necklace on a bust with flowers in the background

shortDescription: A statement temple necklace with sculpted motifs in 22KT gold.
description: Maharani draws on South Indian temple artistry, with repoussé-style motifs linked into a fluid collar. Composed for bridal and ceremonial dressing, it sits gracefully at the collarbone.

name: Kundan-Style Bridal Necklace Set

images.alt: Bridal necklace and earrings displayed on a mannequin
Bridal necklace set with matching earrings

shortDescription: Necklace with matching earrings, set in the kundan tradition.

name: Beaded Heritage Gold Necklace

images.alt: Gold necklace with intricate bead detailing on blue velvet
Gold necklace and matching earrings on display

shortDescription: Hand-strung gold beads with intricate granulated spacers.

name: Pearl Strand Gold Necklace

images.alt: Gold necklace with pearls on a red background
Gold and pearl necklace on a wooden box

name: Everyday Layered Gold Necklace

images.alt: Layered gold necklace on white fabric
Woman wearing a fine layered gold necklace

name: Classic Rope Gold Chain

images.alt: Rope gold chain on a white surface
Gold rope chain on grey fabric

name: Cuban Link Gold Chain

Man wearing a gold link chain

name: Statement Curb Gold Chain

name: Paperclip Link Gold Bracelet

Pair of gold bangles on a wooden box

Gold bangles worn on the wrist
